title: Where Is the Green Sheep?
author: Mem Fox

hero.name: Green Sheep
hero.description: A simple green sheep — the missing sheep sought throughout the book; generic enough that a Boardmaker sheep symbol with green colouring may work, but the specific 'green sheep' identity is central to the book's concept
hero.source_note: Use standard Boardmaker sheep symbol; pair with green colour overlay or label. Activity_images already has 'sheep' — use that as hero base.

notes: This book is built almost entirely around contrasting pairs (up/down, near/far, fast/slow, loud/quiet, big/small, thin/fat) and sheep in different scenarios (sleeping, scared, bath). The existing activity_images and aac_extras already cover the core vocabulary extremely well — sleeping sheep, loud sheep, scared sheep, thin sheep, bath sheep are in activity_images; up, down, near, far, loud, quiet, fast, slow, big, small are in aac_extras. The fringe_11 here draws entirely from those existing assets to avoid duplication. 'quiet', 'big', and 'small' were omitted from fringe_11 in favour of 'scared' and 'bath' since quiet/big/small are already in aac_extras and accessible via core. The HERO slot should use the existing 'sheep' activity image with a green label. No new sourcing is required for this board — all vocabulary is covered by existing assets.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap
